description: Convert an ASCII art diagram into a polished visual diagram. Use this tool when the user has an existing ASCII art representation of a system, flow, or architecture and wants it rendered as a proper diagram. Accepts box-drawing characters, arrow representations (-->, ==>), and plain text layouts. Returns a link to view and edit the generated diagram in the browser.

content.description:
Raw ASCII art diagram to convert into a polished visual diagram. Include the full ASCII art as-is, with box-drawing characters, arrows, or plain text layout. Example:
  +--------+     +--------+
  | Client | --> | Server |
  +--------+     +--------+

diagramType.description: Preferred diagram type. Leave blank to let the AI infer from the ASCII layout.

isIconEnabled.description: Set to true when the user asks to include icons in the diagram.

prompt.description: Additional instruction for rendering. Example: "Use a dark theme and add icons"

name: generate_diagram_from_ascii
